title: Al-Humazah 104:4-6 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 16 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Humazah 104:4-6 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 16. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ (٤) وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ (٥) نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ (٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,

keywords.def: the Crusher, a name of the Fire

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Humazah 104:4-6 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 104:4-6 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: 104:5 asks a question. What is it about?
questions.a: A) What the Crusher is. 104:5: 'And what can make you know what is the Crusher?'

questions.q: Al-Humazah 104:5: «وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: The one who loves money thinks it will make him live forever. Can anything make us live forever in this world?
questions.a: No. Only Allah lives forever; the mocker will be thrown into the Crusher (104:4 to 6).
